verdict.rationale: Dynamics 365 Sales documents connecting sales records with LinkedIn to add data about people and organizations. Its Sales Qualification Agent also researches leads using external data. Together these give a thin, first-party form of record enrichment, but there is no evidence that contact or account fields are populated automatically. Missing for 10: explicit automatic enrichment of contact/account fields, documented firmographic attributes (industry, size, revenue), contact data like emails/phones, ops-level configuration of enrichment, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can have contact and company records auto-enriched with firmographic and contact data

citations.quote: connect sales records with LinkedIn to enhance business processes with data about people, organizations, and relationships
Sales Qualification Agent autonomously researches leads using internal and external data
